title: Multi-sourced AI Tutor for Non-Native English Speaker Students
abstract: arXiv:2610.22163v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being adopted as teaching tools in computing education, particularly for developing AI tutors capable of answering student questions. With the rise in enrollment of international students in computing programs, researchers have begun to explore the difficulties that non-native English speaker (NNES) students face in computing courses due to language barriers. To aid such students, we developed a general-purpose AI tutor system that can process student questions in foreign languages (currently focused on Mandarin) and provide bilingual responses. Our system also incorporates the functionality of generating a glossary of technical terms and their explanations to enhance comprehension. translated_title: 面向非英语母语学生的多源AI导师
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在计算机教育中正被越来越多地用作教学工具，尤其是用于开发能够回答学生问题的AI导师。随着计算机专业国际学生入学人数的上升，研究人员已开始探索非英语母语（NNES）学生因语言障碍在计算机课程中所面临的困难。为了帮助这类学生，我们开发了一个通用型AI导师系统，该系统能够处理学生用外语（目前以中文为主）提出的问题，并提供双语回答。我们的系统还集成了生成技术术语及其解释的词汇表功能，以增强学生的理解能力。我们的方法采用了一种专门的检索增强生成（RAG）流水线，并配有新颖的问题提取机制，使我们能够有效地利用多样化的课程材料来回答学生问题。
tldr: 本文开发了一个面向非英语母语学生的AI导师系统，能够处理外语提问、提供双语回答并生成技术术语词汇表，其核心创新在于采用带有新颖问题提取机制的RAG流水线，从而有效利用多种课程材料。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an AI tutor system for non-native English speaker students that processes questions in foreign languages, provides bilingual responses, and generates technical term glossaries, with its key innovation being a specialized RAG pipeline featuring a novel question extraction mechanism to effectively leverage diverse course materials.
